search_window.scope: Supplementary recall discovery since prior hourly watch, not first-publication-time gate; Gaza-only, production remains authoritative.

findings.title: Gaza medical sources warn generator oil shortage threatens electricity in critical hospital departments
findings.location: Gaza Strip, hospitals not individually named
findings.affected_population_or_system: Hospital backup generators, electricity supply to critical life-saving care departments, hospitalized patients
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Medical sources in Gaza have warned that dwindling supplies of oil needed to operate hospital generators threaten to disrupt electricity supplies to critical departments providing life-saving care.

bounded_discovery_context.publication_vs_window: The WAFA 11:00 local Palestine article appears to precede this observation window; this is a recall finding discovered this run, not confirmed first-reported or newly occurring during the hour.
bounded_discovery_context.quantitative_detail: WAFA says hospitals need over 2,500 liters of generator oil monthly.
bounded_discovery_context.qualification: Anadolu describes the same Health Ministry warning as generator 'fuel' exhausted, but WAFA specifies generator oil; do not equate lubricating oil shortage with complete diesel-fuel depletion without primary confirmation.
bounded_discovery_context.dedupe_required: Production must check whether this alert or precursor is already in the primary Gaza collector.
